title: Committee of Supply – Head W (Ministry of Transport)
what_it_is: Committee of Supply – Head W (Ministry of Transport)

sections.label: MOT expenditure ten years ago
sections.summary: In financial year 2009, MOT's expenditure was approximately $5.4 billion.

sentences.speaker: Mr Sitoh Yih Pin (Potong Pasir)
sentences.text: Ten years ago, in financial year 2009, MOT's expenditure was approximately $5.4 billion.

sections.label: Land Transport Master Plan 2040
sections.summary: The Land Transport Master Plan 2040 sets out a vision for an inclusive transport system with 20-minute town and 45-minute city targets.

sentences.speaker: Mr Sitoh Yih Pin (Potong Pasir)
sentences.text: However, the recently released Land Transport Master Plan (LTMP) 2040 sets out the vision which I believe all Singaporeans can aspire and look forward to.

sentences.speaker: Mr Sitoh Yih Pin (Potong Pasir)
sentences.text: It is an ambitious plan to build a transportation system that is inclusive, promotes healthy and safe journeys that can be completed within the target of 20-minute town and 45-minute city for all.

sections.label: MRT reliability and satisfaction
sections.summary: MRT Mean Kilometres Between Failure rose from 181,000 in 2017 to 690,000 in 2018, and satisfaction rose from 7.5 to 7.9.

sentences.speaker: Mr Sitoh Yih Pin (Potong Pasir)
sentences.text: The Mean Kilometres Between Failure (MKBF) for the entire MRT network increased from 181,000 train kilometres in 2017 to 690,000 train kilometres in 2018.

sentences.speaker: Mr Sitoh Yih Pin (Potong Pasir)
sentences.text: The latest annual Public Transport Customer Satisfaction Survey showed an improvement in commuters’ satisfaction for MRT rising from 7.5 out of 10 in 2017 to 7.9 in 2018.

sections.label: SMRT and SBST losses
sections.summary: Minister Khaw Boon Wan had shared that increased maintenance and renewal costs resulted in significant losses for SMRT and SBST.

sentences.speaker: Mr Sitoh Yih Pin (Potong Pasir)
sentences.text: Minister Khaw Boon Wan had previously shared with this House that the increased maintenance and renewal costs of our train systems at Singapore MRT (SMRT) and Singapore Bus Services Transit (SBST) have resulted in significant losses for both companies in the past financial year.

sections.label: Port and Changi Airport growth
sections.summary: Singapore created world-class infrastructure at Keppel port and Changi Airport, moved the port to Tuas, and is expanding Changi Airport with Terminal 5.

sentences.speaker: Mr Sitoh Yih Pin (Potong Pasir)
sentences.text: Over the years, Singapore has managed to create a world-class infrastructure and regulatory environment at our port in Keppel and Changi Airport to spur growth in both the aviation and maritime industries.

sentences.speaker: Mr Sitoh Yih Pin (Potong Pasir)
sentences.text: As of now, we have moved our port from Keppel to Tuas and continue to improve and expand Changi Airport, with Terminal 5 as the next phase.

sections.label: Air and sea hub plans
sections.summary: The speaker invites the Acting Minister for Transport to share plans for keeping air and sea hubs competitive, and says RTS is more important than HSR.

sentences.speaker: Mr Sitoh Yih Pin (Potong Pasir)
sentences.text: As we move towards the future, we must ensure that our air and sea hubs continue to remain relevant and competitive.

sentences.speaker: Mr Sitoh Yih Pin (Potong Pasir)
sentences.text: I would, therefore, like to invite the Acting Minister for Transport to share with us the Ministry's current and/or future plans on how we can continue to do so and also to address the other issues raised with regard to the future of transportation in Singapore.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ang Wei Neng (Jurong)
sentences.text: Between the High Speed Rail (HSR) and Rapid Transit System (RTS) between Singapore and Johor, RTS will be more important as it will bring immediate relief to 300,000 people who cross the Causeway and second link on a daily basis.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ang Wei Neng (Jurong)
sentences.text: RTS will be able to carry 10,000 passengers per hour and will add a capacity of 60,000 users crossing the Causeway during peak hours.

sections.label: Singapore Flight Information Region discussion
sections.summary: Discussion of the Singapore FIR has returned amid Malaysia's military training area plan and its announcement to take back parts of the FIR, and Indonesian lobbying over the Riau Islands.

sentences.speaker: Mr Pritam Singh (Aljunied)
sentences.text: Chairman, discussion about the Singapore Flight Information Region (FIR) has come under the spotlight again and, in recent times, particularly with Malaysia's intention to impose a military training area above Pasir Gudang, including its announcement to, I quote, "take back", unquote, parts of the Singapore FIR from our management, some quarters in Indonesia have similarly lobbied to reclaim sovereignty of the Singapore FIR over the Riau Islands for several years now.

sentences.speaker: Mr Pritam Singh (Aljunied)
sentences.text: Realigning parts of the Singapore FIR to mirror territorial boundaries would risk creating a severely fragmented airspace around Singapore, with serious aviation safety risks for all users.

sections.label: Bus fares and operating costs
sections.summary: Based on LTA data, bus fares under the Government Contracting Model cover only half of operating costs today.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Walter Theseira (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: Based on data from the Land Transport Authority (LTA), under the Government Contracting Model (GCM), the fares we pay for buses only cover half of the operating costs today.

sections.label: Marsiling MRT train fault
sections.summary: A train fault at Marsiling MRT station on 22 January 2019 lasted an hour during the morning rush hour, delaying commuters in both directions.

sentences.speaker: Mr Dennis Tan Lip Fong (Non-Constituency Member)
sentences.text: For example, a train fault at Marsiling MRT station during the morning rush hour on 22 January 2019, lasted an hour, causing delays for commuters travelling in both directions.

sections.label: MKBF statistics and short delays
sections.summary: The MKBF statistics, an internationally recognised rail reliability indicator, do not include delays of not more than five minutes.

sentences.speaker: Mr Dennis Tan Lip Fong (Non-Constituency Member)
sentences.text: Please allow me to revisit some of the points I made in my earlier Adjournment Motion speech.

sentences.speaker: Mr Dennis Tan Lip Fong (Non-Constituency Member)
sentences.text: However, these MKBF statistics, while an internationally recognised indicator for rail reliability, does not include delays of not more than five minutes.

sections.label: Rail capacity and fare prices
sections.summary: With rail capacity expected to double by 2030, the NCF will be rising and help contribute to future rising fare prices.

sentences.speaker: Mr Dennis Tan Lip Fong (Non-Constituency Member)
sentences.text: With rail capacity expected to double by 2030, the NCF will, no doubt, be only rising, and help contribute to future rising fare prices.

sections.label: PTO profitability in fare formula
sections.summary: The profitability of the Public Transport Operator should also be a factor in the PTC's fare review formula.

sentences.speaker: Mr Dennis Tan Lip Fong (Non-Constituency Member)
sentences.text: The profitability of the Public Transport Operator (PTO) should also be a factor in the PTC's fare review formula.

sections.label: Fossil fuel vehicles ban deadline
sections.summary: The speaker echoes a call for the Government to set a future deadline for a total fossil fuel vehicles ban, and declares his union and PTC interests.

sentences.speaker: Mr Dennis Tan Lip Fong (Non-Constituency Member)
sentences.text: To focus minds on this agenda, I echo my colleague Leon Perera's call for the Government to set a future deadline for a total fossil fuel vehicles ban, like what the United Kingdom and France have done.

sentences.speaker: Mr Arasu Duraisamy (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: Chairman, Sir, I would, first, like to declare my interest as the General Secretary of the Singapore Port Workers Union and also a member of PTC.

sections.label: Tuas West to Tuas Port distance
sections.summary: The distance from Tuas West station to Tuas Port Terminal Phase 1 is about 12 to 13 km, roughly 20 minutes, with one feeder bus from Tuas Bus Terminal.

sentences.speaker: Mr Arasu Duraisamy (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: The distance from Tuas West station to Tuas Port Terminal Phase 1 is approximately 12 kilometres (km) to 13 km, with a travelling time of about 20 minutes.

sentences.speaker: Mr Arasu Duraisamy (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: Currently, there is one feeder bus service from Tuas Bus Terminal serving Tuas South Avenue 14.

sections.label: MRT line to Tuas South
sections.summary: The speaker requests the Minister for Transport study building an MRT line to Tuas South, possibly via Jurong Island, citing long daily commutes.

sentences.speaker: Mr Arasu Duraisamy (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: Having to commute daily to work for more than 90 minutes back and forth can take a toll and certainly not what we want to subject our fellow Singaporeans to.

sentences.speaker: Mr Arasu Duraisamy (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: I would humbly request the Minister for Transport to do a feasibility study on building an MRT line to Tuas South.

sentences.speaker: Mr Arasu Duraisamy (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: This line can run via Jurong Island as there is also a need for transport for workers working over there.

sections.label: Rail and bus ridership growth
sections.summary: Singapore has about 228 km of rapid rail tracks, with 3.5 million daily MRT and LRT rides and over 7.5 million daily bus or train commuters.

sentences.speaker: Ms Low Yen Ling (Chua Chu Kang)
sentences.text: Chairman, today we have about 228 km of rapid rail tracks, a growth of 14% from 2017.

sentences.speaker: Ms Low Yen Ling (Chua Chu Kang)
sentences.text: Ridership has risen by over 5% to 3.5 million rides taking place on the MRT and Light Rail Transit (LRT) each day.

sentences.speaker: Ms Low Yen Ling (Chua Chu Kang)
sentences.text: More than 7.5 million commuters use the bus or train each day and that is a jump of almost 4% from 2017.

sections.label: LTA 2040 transport goals
sections.summary: LTA released transport goals envisioning a healthy and safe 20-minute town and a 45-Minute City for Singapore by 2040.

sentences.speaker: Ms Low Yen Ling (Chua Chu Kang)
sentences.text: As a result, LTA released its latest transport goals that envision healthy and safe 20-minute town and a 45-Minute City for Singapore by year 2040.

sections.label: Hume residents unserved track stretch
sections.summary: Hume residents value convenience, connectivity and shorter travelling times, but face a 2.6 km unserved stretch between Hillview and Beauty World MRT stations.

sentences.speaker: Ms Low Yen Ling (Chua Chu Kang)
sentences.text: Just like the survey respondents, Hume residents, too, place top value on convenience, connectivity and shorter travelling times.

sentences.speaker: Ms Low Yen Ling (Chua Chu Kang)
sentences.text: However, the residents staying in and around Hume are presently caught in a long 2.6 km unserved stretch of tracks between Hillview MRT station and Beauty World MRT station.

sections.label: Hume MRT station construction approval
sections.summary: The speaker asks for approval to build Hume MRT station, citing the Ministry's commitment and area development plans.

sentences.speaker: Ms Low Yen Ling (Chua Chu Kang)
sentences.text: In fact, in the last seven years – this is the eighth year I am making a case for Hume MRT station – and I remember Transport Minister Khaw Boon Wan – we all wish him a speedy and smooth recovery – had responded to me in Parliament last year with the kind assurance that the Ministry is committed to opening Hume MRT station in good time and in pace with potential growth in ridership and development of the Hume area.

sentences.speaker: Ms Low Yen Ling (Chua Chu Kang)
sentences.text: With plans for the development of the Rail Corridor, the former Bukit Timah Fire Station, LTA's vision of a 45-minute city, the time has now come to approve the construction of Hume MRT station and translate the hopes of the residents staying in and around Hume into reality.

sections.label: Hillview Avenue covered walkways
sections.summary: Covered walkways of 1,066 metres on one side of Hillview Avenue run from Hillview Park to Lam Soon Building.

sentences.speaker: Ms Low Yen Ling (Chua Chu Kang)
sentences.text: The 1,066 metres of covered walkways on one side at Hillview Avenue, from Hillview Park all the way to Hillview Green and now extending to Lam Soon Building, has served our residents well.

sections.label: Distance between two bus stops
sections.summary: About 280 metres separate the old 308 bus stop, No 44879, and the new 991 bus stop, No 44889.

sentences.speaker: Ms Low Yen Ling (Chua Chu Kang)
sentences.text: In addition, there is now a distance of about 280 metres between the old 308 bus stop, which is bus stop No 44879, and the new 991 bus stop, which is bus stop No 44889 – 280 metres between these two bus stops.

sections.label: NS Hub in Bukit Gombak
sections.summary: The new National Service Hub will be built in Bukit Gombak in 2023, near Hillview and Gombak Drive.

sentences.speaker: Ms Low Yen Ling (Chua Chu Kang)
sentences.text: Come 2023, the new National Service (NS) Hub will be built in Bukit Gombak, near Hillview and Gombak Drive.

sections.label: Bus connectivity for Bukit Gombak and Hillview
sections.summary: The speaker asks LTA to re-examine bus connectivity between Bukit Gombak Neighbourhood Centre and Hillview and provide linking buses.

sentences.speaker: Ms Low Yen Ling (Chua Chu Kang)
sentences.text: Let not the lack of public transport be a hindrance to bringing residents staying in the same constituency closer together.

sentences.speaker: Ms Low Yen Ling (Chua Chu Kang)
sentences.text: We hope that LTA will re-examine the lack of bus connectivity between Bukit Gombak Neighbourhood Centre and the Hillview areas and provide buses to link up our estate.

sentences.speaker: Ms Low Yen Ling (Chua Chu Kang)
sentences.text: This need has become more urgent now, with the location of NS Hub in our backyard by 2023.

sentences.speaker: Ms Low Yen Ling (Chua Chu Kang)
sentences.text: NS men accessing the hub from the Bukit Gombak side will benefit from the direct buses heading towards Hillview area.

sentences.speaker: Ms Low Yen Ling (Chua Chu Kang)
sentences.text: In addition, connecting the Hillview and Gombak areas to the North South Line and Downtown Line respectively will certainly expand transport options and encourage more of Bukit Gombak residents to go car-lite and bring us closer to green and sustainable living.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ang Wei Neng
sentences.text: Chairman, as we expand the rail network to 360 km by 2030, we will have to build up sufficient local expertise to build tunnels, railways, MRT stations as well as maintaining the train rolling stock and other components.

sections.label: Sungei Bedok MRT station contract
sections.summary: The contract to build Sungei Bedok MRT station and its tunnels was awarded to local firm KTC Civil Engineering and Construction.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ang Wei Neng
sentences.text: For instance, the contract to build the Sungei Bedok MRT station and its tunnels was awarded to local firm KTC Civil Engineering and Construction.

sections.label: Rail network expansion by 2030
sections.summary: MOT announced that by 2030, eight in 10 households will be within a 10-minute walk of MRT stations as the rail network grows to 360 km.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ang Wei Neng
sentences.text: MOT has announced that by 2030, eight in 10 households will be within a 10-minute walk of MRT stations as our rail network increases to 360 km by then.

sections.label: Taxis and private hire cars
sections.summary: There are an estimated 22,000 taxis and 44,000 private hire cars, and these 66,000 vehicles still cannot meet peak hour demands.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ang Wei Neng
sentences.text: Today, we have an estimated 22,000 taxis and 44,000 private hire cars, and these 66,000 vehicles still cannot meet the peak hour demands.

sections.label: One company dominating booking market
sections.summary: One company now dominates the vehicle booking market in Singapore and fares rise compared to days with high promotion codes.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ang Wei Neng
sentences.text: The result is that we have one company now dominating the vehicle booking market in Singapore and the fares start to rise as compared to days with high promotion codes.

sections.label: Taxi arrival time regulation
sections.summary: Taxi companies must ensure their taxis arrive within 10 minutes most of the time under current regulation.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ang Wei Neng
sentences.text: For taxi companies, on the other hand, they have to ensure that their taxis arrive within 10 minutes most of the time based on current regulation.

sections.label: P2P transport sector review
sections.summary: Taxis face six-monthly inspections and drivers must be over 30, while private hire cars are not subject to the same regulations, so a review is timely.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ang Wei Neng
sentences.text: To ensure public safety, taxis are subjected to six-monthly inspections and taxi drivers have to be more than 30 years old, a proxy of how experienced a driver could be.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ang Wei Neng
sentences.text: Private hire cars are not subjected to the same regulations today.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ang Wei Neng
sentences.text: In short, I agree that a review of the P2P transport sector is timely.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ang Hin Kee (Ang Mo Kio)
sentences.text: The Government had taken a light-touch regulatory approach towards ride-hailing apps.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ang Hin Kee (Ang Mo Kio)
sentences.text: There are now, some say 60,000, some say 40,000 private hire vehicles and about 20,000 taxis on the road.

sections.label: Operator exclusivity not allowed
sections.summary: Many feared excessive power by one big player, but the authority announced earlier that exclusivity by operators will not be allowed.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ang Hin Kee (Ang Mo Kio)
sentences.text: Many feared then that it would lead to excessive power owned by one big player.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ang Hin Kee (Ang Mo Kio)
sentences.text: I am glad that the authority has announced earlier that exclusivity by operators will not be allowed.

sections.label: Hired trip and licence growth
sections.summary: Daily hired trips grew to about 1.2 million from about a million five years ago, with about 130,000 taxi and private hire vocational licence holders.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ang Hin Kee (Ang Mo Kio)
sentences.text: As it is, the growth in commuters is slowing.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ang Hin Kee (Ang Mo Kio)
sentences.text: I estimate about 1.2 million daily hired trips now compared to about a million five years ago.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ang Hin Kee (Ang Mo Kio)
sentences.text: But we have now about 130,000 taxi and private hire vocational licence holders.

sections.label: Ride-hailing regulation split
sections.summary: In ride-hailing, LTA handles driver licensing while CCCS oversees market conduct after the Grab-Uber merger.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Walter Theseira
sentences.text: For example, in ride-hailing, today, LTA handles driver licensing, while the Competition and Consumer Commission of Singapore (CCCS) oversees market conduct due to the recent Grab-Uber merger.

sections.label: On-Demand Public Bus trial
sections.summary: LTA's On-Demand Public Bus trial lets commuters request pickups and drop-offs at any bus stop in defined areas via a mobile app, with about 6,000 trips and 20,000 app downloads in two months.

sentences.speaker: Mr Melvin Yong Yik Chye (Tanjong Pagar)
sentences.text: LTA recently launched a trial of  On-Demand Public Bus (ODPB) services which allow commuters to request pickups and drop-offs at any bus stop within defined areas, using a mobile application.

sentences.speaker: Mr Melvin Yong Yik Chye (Tanjong Pagar)
sentences.text: Last week, LTA announced that about 6,000 trips have been taken in the first two months of the trial with about 20,000 app downloads.

sections.label: ODPB in low-density areas
sections.summary: The ODPB concept will be useful where low population density makes fixed scheduled buses financially unviable, such as private landed estates.

sentences.speaker: Mr Melvin Yong Yik Chye (Tanjong Pagar)
sentences.text: The ODPB concept will certainly be useful in areas where there is low financial viability to deploy fixed and scheduled buses due to a low population density, such as private landed estates of which I have plenty in my constituency.

sections.label: Driverless transition for transport workers
sections.summary: With more than 10,000 bus captains, the member urges the Ministry to set up a tripartite committee with the union and transport operators to oversee AVs' impact on transport workers.

sentences.speaker: Mr Melvin Yong Yik Chye (Tanjong Pagar)
sentences.text: We need to take action sooner, rather than later, to help our public transport workers transition into a driverless world.

sentences.speaker: Mr Melvin Yong Yik Chye (Tanjong Pagar)
sentences.text: There are more than 10,000 bus captains, of whom many have been driving as a livelihood for decades.

sentences.speaker: Mr Melvin Yong Yik Chye (Tanjong Pagar)
sentences.text: I, therefore, urge the Ministry to set up a tripartite committee to work with the union and the transport operators to oversee the impact of the development of AVs on transport workers in Singapore.

sections.label: E-scooter rules and bike operators
sections.summary: The e-scooter footpath speed limit was cut to 10 km/h and registration required; oBike has gone under and Ofo suspended, prompting a question on last-mile connectivity.

sentences.speaker: Mr Yee Chia Hsing (Chua Chu Kang)
sentences.text: Since then, the speed limit of 15 km/hour (h) for e-scooters on footpaths has been reduced to 10 km/h and owners of e-scooters are required to register their e-scooters.

sentences.speaker: Mr Yee Chia Hsing (Chua Chu Kang)
sentences.text: OBike has gone under and Ofo bike has been suspended for failing to meet the new requirements to prevent indiscriminate parking.

sentences.speaker: Mr Yee Chia Hsing (Chua Chu Kang)
sentences.text: With the demise of oBike and Ofo, possibly the two operators with the largest fleet of bikes, what is the Ministry doing to ensure that last-mile connectivity is not compromised?

sections.label: ASEAN air services liberalisation
sections.summary: Since the 2009 ASEAN Air Services Agreement liberalised air rights for ASEAN airlines, passenger traffic within ASEAN has grown by more than 90%.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
sentences.text: For example, since the first ASEAN Air Services Agreement was signed in 2009 to liberalise air rights for ASEAN airlines for flights within ASEAN, passenger traffic within ASEAN has grown by more than 90%.

sections.label: ASEAN-China air transport agreement
sections.summary: Since the 2011 ASEAN-China Air Transport Agreement, direct links increased more than fivefold to over 500, and Chinese tourists to Southeast Asia and Singapore grew.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
sentences.text: Since the signing of the ASEAN-China Air Transport Agreement in 2011, direct links have increased more than fivefold to over 500, providing more flexible and convenient travel options between China and Southeast Asia.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
sentences.text: In 2018, the number of Chinese tourists to Southeast Asia reached 25 million, up from 10 million before the Agreement.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
sentences.text: For Singapore, the number of Chinese tourists visiting Singapore grew from 1.6 million to 3.4 million.

sections.label: CCI-ILSTC trade corridor
sections.summary: The New International Land Sea Trade Corridor under the Chongqing Connectivity Initiative, known as CCI-ILSTC, is one example.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
sentences.text: The New International Land Sea Trade Corridor under the Chongqing Connectivity Initiative, also known as CCI-ILSTC, is one example.

sections.label: Shipping and aviation emissions measures
sections.summary: Singapore supports IMO ship emission efforts, will implement a 0.5% sulphur cap and LNG marine fuel by 2020, and contributed to ICAO's CORSIA.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
sentences.text: For example, Singapore is supportive of the IMO's efforts to address the environmental impact caused by ship emissions.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
sentences.text: We will be implementing the 0.5% sulphur emission cap and preparing our port to supply liquefied natural gas as a clean marine fuel by 2020.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
sentences.text: On the aviation front, Singapore contributed extensively to ICAO's efforts in addressing international aviation carbon dioxide emissions through the implementation of the Carbon Offsetting and Reduction Scheme for International Aviation (CORSIA).

sections.label: Same Risk Area ballast water
sections.summary: Singapore is collaborating with Malaysia and Indonesia to implement a Same Risk Area for ballast water management, following IMO's approval.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
sentences.text: For example, Singapore is now collaborating with Malaysia and Indonesia to implement a "Same Risk Area" for ballast water management, following IMO's approval of the concept.

sections.label: Tuas Terminal reclamation progress
sections.summary: Reclamation works for Tuas Terminal are progressing well, and the first phase of operations is on track to commence in 2021.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
sentences.text: Reclamation works for Tuas Terminal are progressing well, and we are on track to commence the first phase of operations in 2021.

sections.label: Sea Transport Industry Digital Plan
sections.summary: MPA, IMDA and Enterprise Singapore will roll out the Sea Transport Industry Digital Plan under the SMEs Go Digital Programme to support SMEs.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
sentences.text: To support small and medium enterprises (SMEs), the Maritime and Port Authority of Singapore (MPA), in collaboration with the Infocomm Media Development Authority and Enterprise Singapore, will roll out the Sea Transport Industry Digital Plan (IDP) under the SMEs Go Digital Programme.

sections.label: Air Traffic Management Programme Fund
sections.summary: The $200 million Centre of Excellence for Air Traffic Management Programme Fund was established in 2012, with $142 million committed, including a smart digital tower prototype.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
sentences.text: The Centre of Excellence for Air Traffic Management Programme Fund of $200 million was established in 2012 and, as of now, $142 million has been committed for research and development projects in air traffic management.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
sentences.text: For example, the Centre of Excellence initiated research activities to explore a smart digital tower concept for high intensity operations at Changi Airport.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
sentences.text: This project has progressed from the laboratory to the field where we have commenced the development of a smart digital tower prototype in January 2018.

sections.label: Maritime Drone Estate launch
sections.summary: MPA and CAAS will launch the Maritime Drone Estate near Marina South Pier to support innovative uses of drones.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
sentences.text: To support innovative uses of drones, MPA and CAAS will launch the Maritime Drone Estate near Marina South Pier.

sections.label: Unmanned Aircraft Regulatory Framework
sections.summary: CAAS is looking into strengthening the Unmanned Aircraft Regulatory Framework, which may include mandatory drone registration.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
sentences.text: To ensure that drones are operated safely, CAAS is also looking into strengthening the Unmanned Aircraft Regulatory Framework.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
sentences.text: This may include the mandatory registration of drones.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
sentences.text: For example, Jewel Changi Airport will open up over 2,000 new retail and hospitality jobs.

sections.label: Work-Learn Technical Diploma in Port Automation
sections.summary: PSA and ITE run the Work-Learn Technical Diploma in Port Automation Technology, combining classroom teaching and on-the-job training at PSA.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
sentences.text: Aspiring port engineers can enroll in the Work-Learn Technical Diploma in Port Automation Technology, run by PSA and the Institute of Technical Education (ITE).

sentences.speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
sentences.text: It helps our students and workers acquire skillsets necessary for a highly automated port, through a combination of structured classroom teaching and on-the-job training at PSA.

sections.label: Aviation and shore-based job training
sections.summary: MPA will introduce another ELP for shore-based jobs and CAAS will enhance course fee support for Passenger Service Agents ELP modular certifications.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
sentences.text: She is now working towards completing the three remaining Modular Certificates to obtain a Diploma in Aviation Management from Temasek Polytechnic.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
sentences.text: This year, MPA will introduce another ELP for shore-based jobs in the ship owning, ship operating and ship broking sectors.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
sentences.text: And CAAS will enhance the course fee support to cover three additional modular certifications for the Passenger Service Agents ELP.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
sentences.text: Mr Chairman, as we reflect on our past and chart our plans for the future, we know that a Singapore that is well-connected to the world is key to our success.

sections.label: Seniors' falls and suggestions
sections.summary: A speaker says the returning Member will pursue Members' suggestions and reminds everyone that one-third of seniors in Singapore sustain fall injuries yearly.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
sentences.text: He also asked me to reassure Members that he will actively pursue all your suggestions and advice when he returns.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
sentences.text: He has also asked me to remind everyone that every year in Singapore, one-third of seniors sustain injuries from falls.

sections.label: Transport spending more than doubled
sections.summary: Mr Sitoh Yih Pin emphasised that Government transport spending more than doubled in 10 years, from $5.4 billion in 2009 to $11.5 billion in 2019.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
sentences.text: Mr Sitoh Yih Pin has emphasised that the Government's spending on transport has more than doubled over the last 10 years, from $5.4 billion in 2009 to now $11.5 billion in 2019, a doubling in 10 years.

sections.label: TEL adds stations and kilometres
sections.summary: TEL will add 32 stations and 43 km to the MRT network and eventually serve up to one million commuters.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
sentences.text: TEL will add another 32 stations and 43 km more to our MRT network and eventually serve up to one million commuters.

sections.label: Improved rail reliability noted
sections.summary: Mr Sitoh Yih Pin noted improved rail reliability, with MKBF of 690,000 train-km in 2018, more than triple the 181,000 train-km in 2017.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
sentences.text: Mr Sitoh Yih Pin has noted the improved rail reliability.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)

sections.label: Bus Contracting Model bid prices

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)

sections.label: Morning pre-peak commuter increase

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
sentences.text: The number of commuters travelling during the morning pre-peak period has now increased by about 12%.

sections.label: Public transport subsidies and spending

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
sentences.text: The Government will also spend another $26 billion to expand the bus and rail networks, also over the next five years.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
sentences.text: In fact, over the last decade, monthly expenditure on public transport, as a proportion of household income for the lower-income group, has come down from 4.1% to 2.7%.

sections.label: Malaysia remits abortive costs

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
sentences.text: As part of the agreement, Malaysia agreed, and I can confirm, has remitted to Singapore about S$15 million on 31 January 2019 and this is for the abortive costs that were incurred by Singapore due to the two-year suspension.

sections.label: RTS Link tender and delays
sections.summary: The project is likely to face further delays, and both Governments are obliged to jointly call an open tender for the RTS Link Operating Company.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
sentences.text: Unfortunately, the project is likely to face further delays.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
sentences.text: We are now at the stage where both Governments are obliged to jointly call an open tender to appoint the RTS Link Operating Company (OpCo).

sections.label: RTS Link deadline extension request

sentences.text: Most recently, on 28 February 2019, Malaysia asked for another deadline extension to 31 March 2019.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
sentences.text: Given these delays, the RTS Link service, quite frankly, is no longer on track to commence by the original date of 31 December 2024.

sections.label: Johor Bahru Port Limits extension

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
sentences.text: On 25 October 2018, Malaysia decided to unilaterally extend the Johor Bahru Port Limits into Singapore's territorial waters off Tuas.

sections.label: ICAO approved Kuala Lumpur Kota Kinabalu FIRs
sections.summary: In 1973 ICAO approved creating the Kuala Lumpur and Kota Kinabalu FIRs, carved from the then Singapore FIR and allocated to Malaysia.

sentences.text: In 1973, ICAO approved the creation of the Kuala Lumpur and Kota Kinabalu FIRs which, in fact, were carved out from the then Singapore FIR and allocated to Malaysia.

sections.label: Singapore FIR flights in 2018
sections.summary: In 2018, Singapore managed 740,000 flights in the Singapore FIR.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
sentences.text: In 2018, Singapore managed 740,000 flights in the Singapore FIR.

sections.label: Malaysia Indonesia seek airspace changes
sections.summary: Malaysia and Indonesia have expressed their desire to see changes to existing airspace arrangements in the region.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
sentences.text: Members are aware that our closest neighbours, Malaysia and Indonesia, have expressed their desire to see some changes to these existing airspace arrangements in our region.

sections.label: Suspension extension Seletar ILS Pasir Gudang
sections.summary: Both sides agreed to extend the mutual suspension of the Seletar Airport ILS and the Pasir Gudang Restricted Area until 31 March 2019.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
sentences.text: Following Minister Khaw Boon Wan's meeting with Malaysian Minister of Transport Mr Anthony Loke on 23 January, both sides agreed to extend the mutual suspension of the instrument landing system (ILS) for Seletar Airport, and the Restricted Area over Pasir Gudang until 31 March 2019.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
sentences.text: We have explained to Malaysia that Seletar Airport has been serving charter, medevac and Maintenance, Repair and Overhaul flights without issues for decades and should continue to operate normally.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
sentences.text: I have also personally spoken to Minister Loke on 27 February and we are both closely monitoring the progress of these sensitive discussions between our senior officials.

sections.label: Public consultation panel responses
sections.summary: The Panel considered 7,405 responses over six months from commuters, transport workers, academia, industry partners, unions, students and interest groups.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Dr Janil Puthucheary)
sentences.text: Through this public consultation process, the Panel considered 7,405 responses over six months from commuters, transport workers, academia, industry partners, unions, students and interest groups.

sections.label: 20-Minute Towns and 45-Minute City
sections.summary: By 2040 Singaporeans can look forward to 20-Minute Towns and a 45-Minute City for journeys on public, active and shared transport.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Dr Janil Puthucheary)
sentences.text: By 2040, Singaporeans can look forward to "20-Minute Towns" where almost all journeys to the nearest neighbourhood centre on public, active and shared transport modes can be completed within 20 minutes.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Dr Janil Puthucheary)
sentences.text: Singaporeans will also be able to enjoy a "45-Minute City" where nine in 10 peak hour journeys on public, active and shared transport can be completed within 45 minutes.

sections.label: Transport improvements and commuting time
sections.summary: Improvements in public, active and shared transport would save the average weekday commuter 15 minutes daily by 2040.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Dr Janil Puthucheary)
sentences.text: It will have an impact on traffic flow, congestion and on how we move around our city easily, regardless of how long journey times are today.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Dr Janil Puthucheary)
sentences.text: These improvements in public, active and shared transport would save the average weekday commuter 15 minutes every day by 2040.

sections.label: Reduced operated mileage, ODPB commuters
sections.summary: Operated mileage was cut by over 25% in some areas while most ODPB commuters get journey times comparable to regular buses.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Dr Janil Puthucheary)
sentences.text: Operated mileage has been reduced in some areas by more than 25%, or one quarter, while allowing most ODPB commuters to enjoy journey times comparable to regular bus services.

sections.label: Hume station on DTL2
sections.summary: There are plans to fully fit out and open Hume station on Downtown Line 2.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Dr Janil Puthucheary)
sentences.text: Mayor Low Yen Ling and her residents would be delighted, I hope, to know that we have plans to fully fit out and open Hume station on Downtown Line 2 (DTL2).

sections.label: Ridership justifying Hume station
sections.summary: There will be sufficient ridership to justify opening Hume station.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Dr Janil Puthucheary)
sentences.text: With all these, there will be sufficient ridership to justify opening Hume station.

sections.label: JRL travel to Checkpoint
sections.summary: After the JRL is completed in 2028, travellers can ride it to the Checkpoint before transferring to shuttle or company transport.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Dr Janil Puthucheary)
sentences.text: Once the JRL is completed in 2028, they can travel on the JRL to the Checkpoint before transferring to a shuttle bus or company transport taking them through security and onwards to the various industries on the island.

sections.label: Regional centres and new developments
sections.summary: MOT and LTA are working with other agencies on developments including Jurong Lake District, Jurong Innovation District, Woodlands North Coast and Punggol Digital District.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Dr Janil Puthucheary)
sentences.text: Today, there are already regional centres in Tampines, Woodlands and Jurong East that are well connected to nearby amenities and jobs.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Dr Janil Puthucheary)
sentences.text: We, in MOT and LTA, are collaborating with other agencies on upcoming key developments, including the Jurong Lake District, Jurong Innovation District, Woodlands North Coast and the Punggol Digital District.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Dr Janil Puthucheary)
sentences.text: We do not have any of these yet, but we are going to build some.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Dr Janil Puthucheary)
sentences.text: These will have features, such as dedicated turns and lanes for public and private buses, as well as other types of connectivity, apart from the Transit Priority Corridors to link these developments, such as the new rail projects which we have already announced, that is, the Thomson East-Coast Line and North-East Line extension.

sections.label: BlueSG charging and cleaner energy fleets
sections.summary: BlueSG will roll out 500 charging stations with 2,000 points, having installed 687 points, and by 2040 public buses, taxis and some private hire and rental fleets will use cleaner energy.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Dr Janil Puthucheary)
sentences.text: Under this, BlueSG will roll out a total of 500 charging stations equipped with 2,000 charging points nationwide.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Dr Janil Puthucheary)
sentences.text: To date, BlueSG has installed 687 charging points.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Dr Janil Puthucheary)
sentences.text: By 2040, we will upgrade all our public buses to cleaner energy sources.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Dr Janil Puthucheary)
sentences.text: All the taxi companies and some of the private hire car booking providers and car rental companies have committed to making their entire fleet run on cleaner energy by 2040.

sections.label: Public bus accident rate 2018
sections.summary: Public buses had 0.11 accidents per 100,000 bus service kilometres in 2018, a third lower than 0.15 in 2017.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Dr Janil Puthucheary)
sentences.text: Our public buses had an accident rate of 0.11 accidents per 100,000 bus service kilometres in 2018, a third lower than the 0.15 in 2017.

sections.label: Commuter satisfaction with taxi services
sections.summary: More than 99% of commuters surveyed by PTC were satisfied with taxi and private hire car services in 2018.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Dr Janil Puthucheary)
sentences.text: More than 99% of commuters surveyed by PTC were satisfied with taxi and private hire car services in 2018.

sections.label: Private hire car journey share
sections.summary: Private hire cars account for about 45% of all P2P journeys, with more than 120 million trips completed on them in 2018.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Dr Janil Puthucheary)
sentences.text: Private hire cars are now an important part of our land transport system, accounting for about 45% of all P2P journeys.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Dr Janil Puthucheary)
sentences.text: In 2018, there were more than 120 million trips completed on private hire cars alone.

sections.label: Ban on driver exclusivity arrangements
sections.summary: Operators will be prohibited from tying down drivers through exclusivity arrangements, except operators that employ drivers.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Dr Janil Puthucheary)
sentences.text: First, we will prohibit operators from tying down drivers through exclusivity arrangements, except for those operators that employ drivers.

sections.label: Private Hire Car Tripartite Committee
sections.summary: LTA will establish a Private Hire Car Tripartite Committee to complement the existing Taxi Tripartite Committee.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Dr Janil Puthucheary)
sentences.text: Mr Ang Hin Kee will be pleased to hear that LTA will be establishing a Private Hire Car Tripartite Committee to complement the existing Taxi Tripartite Committee.

sections.label: Open fair procurement for local contractors
sections.summary: The procurement process must stay open and fair so local contractors get opportunities, gain experience from LTA contracts, and secure overseas work.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Dr Janil Puthucheary)
sentences.text: Our procurement process must continue to be open and fair, so that more such opportunities are afforded to our local contractors.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Dr Janil Puthucheary)
sentences.text: Our local companies gain from contracts with LTA.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Dr Janil Puthucheary)
sentences.text: This gives them the experience they need to go beyond our shores and secure overseas work.

sections.label: World-class land transport system commitment
sections.summary: The government is committed to building a world-class land transport system, and LTMP 2040 is a step in that journey with Singaporeans.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Dr Janil Puthucheary)
sentences.text: Mr Chairman, we are committed to building a world-class land transport system for Singapore.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Dr Janil Puthucheary)
sentences.text: LTMP 2040 is yet another step in this journey together with Singaporeans to build the kind of land transport system we want for ourselves and our future.

sections.label: MOT accepts AMAP recommendations
sections.summary: MOT said it would accept all Active Mobility Advisory Panel recommendations for safer path riding and implement them in early 2019.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lim Biow Chuan (Mountbatten)
sentences.text: MOT had also said that they would accept all the recommendations of the Active Mobility Advisory Panel (AMAP) for safer path riding and will implement these recommendations in early 2019.

sentences.text: LTA says that the recommendations of AMAP will be implemented on 1 February 2019.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lim Biow Chuan (Mountbatten)
sentences.text: For example, the speed limit for PMDs and bicycles on footpaths had been reduced to 10 km/h.

sections.label: Compulsory e-scooter registration and insurance
sections.summary: Compulsory registration of e-scooters will make it easy to implement mandatory insurance.

sentences.speaker: Er Dr Lee Bee Wah (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: Compulsory registration of e-scooters will make it easy to implement mandatory insurance.

sections.label: Town Councils deciding cycling bans
sections.summary: It asks whether LTA can consider giving Town Councils power to decide where cycling and PMD riding are banned for residents' safety.

sentences.speaker: Er Dr Lee Bee Wah (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: Can LTA consider giving Town Councils the power to decide where cycling and PMD riding should be banned for the safety of residents, especially young children and the elderly?

sections.label: Delaying commercial shared PMD services
sections.summary: The member asked the Government to delay commercial shared PMD services until riding culture improved, and LTA said operating such a service without a licence is an offence.

sentences.speaker: Mr Dennis Tan Lip Fong
sentences.text: Mr Chairman, last November, I asked the Government to consider delaying the introduction of commercial shared PMD services until the riding culture for PMDs has improved and incidences of unsafe and inconsiderate usage have subsided.

sentences.speaker: Mr Dennis Tan Lip Fong
sentences.text: LTA had to issue a statement reminding all that it is an offence to operate a device-sharing service at public places without a licence.

sentences.speaker: Mr Dennis Tan Lip Fong
sentences.text: In replying to my PQ, Senior Minister of State Lam Pin Min also said that the licence application exercise would only take place in January this year.

sections.label: Increase in PMD fires
sections.summary: Fires involving PMDs rose to 74 last year, a 51% increase from 49 cases in 2017.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling (Pasir Ris-Punggol)
sentences.text: Next, there has been an increase in the number of fires involving PMDs.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling (Pasir Ris-Punggol)
sentences.text: There were 74 such fires last year, a 51% increase from the 49 cases in 2017.

sections.label: PMD sharing operator deposits
sections.summary: Citing oBike's experience, the member asked whether PMD sharing operators will require users to put up deposits.

sentences.speaker: Miss Cheng Li Hui
sentences.text: Having learnt from the experience of oBike which left many users wondering if they could get their deposits back, I would like to ask the Minister if PMD sharing operators will require users to put up deposits.

sections.label: Accessible land transport and reserved seats
sections.summary: The member asked about regulating reserved seats on MRT trains and measures to keep land transport accessible to seniors, families with young children and the disabled.

sentences.speaker: Mr Yee Chia Hsing
sentences.text: Chairman, it is important that we ensure that our land transport system is accessible to seniors, families with young children and the disabled.

sentences.speaker: Mr Yee Chia Hsing
sentences.text: In January this year, I filed a PQ on whether "reserved seats" on MRT trains can be better regulated and enforced as many able-bodied passengers who take up these seats are not giving up the seats to others who may need the seats more.

sentences.speaker: Mr Yee Chia Hsing
sentences.text: Some are "sleeping" and then miraculously know how to wake up when the train reaches their destination.

sentences.speaker: Mr Yee Chia Hsing
sentences.text: I also observed that there are two different designs for the reserved seats.

sentences.speaker: Mr Yee Chia Hsing
sentences.text: Another design is based on a softer approach with a "StandUpStacey Show You Care" sticker above the seat but nothing is pasted on the seat itself.

sentences.speaker: Mr Yee Chia Hsing
sentences.text: Can the Ministry also share what measures are being taken to ensure that our land transport system remains accessible to seniors, families with young children and the disabled, in particular, measures to promote a more caring commuter culture?

sections.label: Off-road cycling path network
sections.summary: By 2030 Singapore will have off-road cycling paths in every HDB town, with LTA building paths in Bukit Panjang and Bishan and expanding networks in Ang Mo Kio and Tampines.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
sentences.text: By 2030, Singapore will have a comprehensive network of off-road cycling paths in every HDB town.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
sentences.text: In addition to the existing 120 km of cycling paths it has built, LTA is constructing cycling paths in Bukit Panjang and Bishan and expanding the cycling network in Ang Mo Kio and Tampines over the next three years.

sections.label: Off-road accidents involving active mobility users
sections.summary: Reported off-road accidents involving active mobility users increased from 132 in 2017 to 251 in 2018.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
sentences.text: The number of reported off-road accidents involving active mobility users increased from 132 in 2017 to 251 in 2018.

sections.label: e-scooter registrations
sections.summary: Over 40,000 e-scooters have been registered to date.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
sentences.text: To date, over 40,000 e-scooters have been registered.

sections.label: active mobility offences detected

sentences.speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
sentences.text: Since May 2018, LTA has detected more than 3,100 active mobility offences, which include unsafe riding on paths and riding of non-compliant devices.

sections.label: ban on non-UL2272 PMD sales
sections.summary: From 1 July 2019, the sale of non-UL2272 certified PMDs will be prohibited to reduce PMD fire risks.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
sentences.text: As I have previously shared in this House, we will prohibit the sale of non-UL2272 certified PMDs from 1 July 2019 to reduce the risk of PMD fire incidents.

sections.label: bicycle-sharing operator licensing regime
sections.summary: A licensing regime for bicycle-sharing operators was introduced last year.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
sentences.text: Last year, we introduced a licensing regime for bicycle-sharing operators.

sections.label: bicycle parking spaces provision
sections.summary: More than 220,000 bicycle parking lots exist islandwide, with a target of 267,000 lots by 2020.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
sentences.text: We have stepped up the provision of bicycle parking spaces by implementing yellow boxes, especially in areas of high demand for bicycle parking.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
sentences.text: We now have more than 220,000 bicycle parking lots islandwide, with all public housing located within a five-minute walk from a public bicycle parking facility.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
sentences.text: We target to provide a total of 267,000 lots by 2020.

sections.label: PMD-sharing licence applications assessment
sections.summary: LTA is assessing PMD-sharing licence applications, licensing only capable operators, starting with fleet sizes up to 500 PMDs under a one-year sandbox licence.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
sentences.text: LTA is assessing the first batch of PMD-sharing licence applications and will only license operators who are capable of managing indiscriminate parking and complying with fire safety requirements and have clear plans to educate users on proper parking, safe riding and fire safety.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
sentences.text: We will start conservatively, with new operators restricted to small fleet sizes of up to 500 PMDs under a one-year sandbox licence period.

sections.label: Barrier-free MRT and bus interchanges
sections.summary: All MRT stations and bus interchanges are already barrier-free under the inclusive land transport infrastructure strategy.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Transport (Mr Baey Yam Keng)
sentences.text: On the first strategy, to design an inclusive land transport infrastructure, all MRT stations and bus interchanges are already barrier-free.

sections.label: Sheltered walkways by 2029
sections.summary: With over 60 new MRT stations underway, another 100 km of sheltered walkways is expected by 2029.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Transport (Mr Baey Yam Keng)
sentences.text: With more than 60 new MRT stations underway, we expect another 100 km of sheltered walkways to be added by 2029.

sections.label: Silver Zones accident rate drop
sections.summary: Silver Zones, introduced in 2014 with narrower roads, speed humps and two-stage crossings, number 15 completed, with accident rates down 75%.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Transport (Mr Baey Yam Keng)
sentences.text: In 2014, we introduced Silver Zones which featured narrower roads and speed humps to reduce traffic speed, and two-stage crossings to allow senior pedestrians to rest at the midpoint.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Transport (Mr Baey Yam Keng)
sentences.text: We have completed 15 Silver Zones, and I am glad that accident rates in these areas have dropped by 75%.

sections.label: LTA average processing time 2018
sections.summary: The average processing time taken by LTA was two weeks in 2018.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Transport (Mr Baey Yam Keng)
sentences.text: The average processing time taken by LTA was two weeks in 2018.

sections.label: Wheelchair-accessible public buses by 2020
sections.summary: Land transport will be made more accessible for commuters with disabilities, with all public buses committed to being wheelchair-accessible by 2020.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Transport (Mr Baey Yam Keng)
sentences.text: We will also make land transport more accessible for commuters with disabilities.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Transport (Mr Baey Yam Keng)
sentences.text: We have committed to making all our public buses wheelchair-accessible by 2020.

sections.label: Supporting transport workers' conditions and training
sections.summary: Operators and unions will work to improve transport workers' conditions and training, with better depots, canteens, lounges and academy training content.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Transport (Mr Baey Yam Keng)
sentences.text: Beyond formal recognition, a simple "hello" or "thank you" or just a smile when we meet a transport worker, can brighten their days.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Transport (Mr Baey Yam Keng)
sentences.text: We will continue to work with operators and unions to improve working conditions and training opportunities for our transport workers.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Transport (Mr Baey Yam Keng)
sentences.text: New and upgraded bus depots and interchanges will have more comfortable staff canteens and lounges.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Transport (Mr Baey Yam Keng)
sentences.text: The Singapore Bus Academy and the Singapore Rail Academy are also working with NTWU, industry partners and voluntary welfare organisations to enhance training content to build capabilities of public transport workers to better serve commuters in need.

sections.label: Heart Zones at MRT stations

sentences.text: Later this year, PTC will implement Heart Zone at Yishun MRT station, in partnership with Yishun Health.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Transport (Mr Baey Yam Keng)
sentences.text: PTC aims to have Heart Zones at all MRT stations near every restructured hospital, for example, in Sengkang and Simei.

sentences.text: The proportion today stands at 64%, that is, 64% of households are within a 10-minute walk.

sentences.text: On how many current trips to the city take less than 45 minutes, if someone stays within 800 metres of a train station, 10-minute walk, three-quarters of those peak period train-only journeys are completed within 45 minutes.

sentences.text: But if you are looking at all peak-hour public journeys today, only 55% are completed within 45 minutes.

sentences.text: The cycling path for Bukit Panjang area is targeted to be completed sometime in 2021.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
sentences.text: This will be a standalone cycling path which is separate from the existing footpaths.

sections.label: Seletar Airport night flight restrictions

sentences.speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
sentences.text: Recently, based on some of the feedback from residents and from the grassroots organisations, we have since 1 January 2019 disallowed flights at Seletar Airport between 10.00 pm and 7.00 am every day, except for emergency and medical evacuation flights.

sections.label: Private Hire Driver age limit
sections.summary: The age limit for the Private Hire Driver Vocational Licence is being studied, with a discrepancy noted against the Taxi Drivers Vocational Licence.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: The age limit for the Private Hire Driver Vocational Licence (PDVL) is something that has been raised in the feedback that we have had as part of the consultation process for the P2P regulatory framework.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: It is not something that we are clear about what the right thing to do is at this point in time.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: It is clear that there is a discrepancy in the age between the PDVL for private hire car drivers and the Taxi Drivers Vocational Licence for taxi drivers.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: We will continue to engage with the industry, as well as the drivers, to see how to deal with this.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: It is something we are studying and we will come back to Mr Ang Hin Kee and the House when we are ready with more information.

sections.label: Convention limitation of liability amendments
sections.summary: The question asks the Senior Minister of State to clarify the status of adopting the 2012 amendments to the 1996 Protocol to the Convention of Limitation of Liability.

sentences.speaker: Mr Dennis Tan Lip Fong
sentences.text: My fourth question is also for Senior Minister of State Lam Pin Min and it is on maritime matters.

sentences.speaker: Mr Dennis Tan Lip Fong
sentences.text: I would be grateful if the Senior Minister of State can clarify: what is the status of the adoption of the 2012 amendments to the 1996 Protocol to the Convention of Limitation of Liability?

sections.label: Singapore air traffic services flights
sections.summary: Singapore provides air traffic services to 740,000 flights, with half landing or taking off from Changi Airport.

sentences.speaker: Dr Vivian Balakrishnan
sentences.text: As I explained earlier on again, there are 740,000 flights which are receiving air traffic services from Singapore as half of those flights land or take off from Changi Airport.

sections.label: Multi-nodal air traffic flow management
sections.summary: Interconnecting regional air traffic control systems lets airports act autonomously while optimising total flow, with CAAS pioneering this and Indonesia and Malaysia participating.

sentences.speaker: Dr Vivian Balakrishnan
sentences.text: The concept behind multi-nodal air traffic flow management is that by interconnecting the air traffic control systems of all the airports in the region, it enables all the airports, first, to continue to act autonomously, but to optimise the total flow and the throughput flying in and leaving from those airports.

sentences.speaker: Dr Vivian Balakrishnan
sentences.text: That is why I have explained that CAAS is pioneering this technique and is doing so in an inclusive and open way.

sentences.speaker: Dr Vivian Balakrishnan
sentences.text: So, both Indonesia and Malaysia are participating with CAAS.

sections.label: Regulatory structure for clean fleet
sections.summary: A regulatory structure is needed because not all private hire car operators agreed to the clean fleet commitment.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: So, we need a regulatory structure in order to get there.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: It is quite telling that despite the fact that we in Government have committed to an entirely clean public bus fleet by 2040 as have the taxi operators, not all the private hire car operators have agreed.

sections.label: Economic sense and diesel price
sections.summary: The change will not happen just because it was asked for; it must make economic sense, including a change to diesel price.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: It is not going to happen just because we have asked it to happen.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: It has to make economic sense and some of that is going to have to include something like a change to the price of diesel which we recently introduced.

sections.label: Penalties for PMD rule flouting
sections.summary: All PMD users, including shared-PMD users, will be penalised for flouting active mobility regulations, and a ban imposed for indiscriminate parking.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
sentences.text: All PMD users, including users of shared-PMDs, will be penalised for flouting the active mobility regulations.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
sentences.text: Separately, for parking indiscriminately, we will impose a ban on users according to how often he breaks the rules.

sections.label: Enforcement at Khatib Centre
sections.summary: The question asks whether LTA will take enforcement action at crowded town centres like Khatib Centre and whether it has sufficient manpower.

sentences.speaker: Er Dr Lee Bee Wah
sentences.text: For crowded town centre areas like Khatib Centre, where residents have been giving feedback that there are a lot of near-miss accidents caused by reckless cycling, is LTA going to take enforcement action at locations like these and whether LTA has sufficient manpower to do the enforcement action?

sections.label: Footpath safety and Active Mobility Act
sections.summary: The use of footpaths, including those in Town Council areas, is regulated under the Active Mobility Act.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
sentences.text: And we understand Er Dr Lee Bee Wah's concern with regard to the safety of pedestrians, especially her residents in her Town Council area.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
sentences.text: But I would also like to reiterate that the use of footpaths, including footpaths in Town Council areas, are regulated under the Active Mobility Act.

sections.label: PTC commuter fares role
sections.summary: PTC will continue to look out for commuters' interests in fares and affordability, and its role needs reconsideration.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: And PTC will continue to look out for the interests of commuters in terms of fares and fare affordability.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: I would agree that we need to reconsider the role of PTC at this point in time.

sections.label: Autonomous vehicle testing timeline
sections.summary: About 70 km of one-north roads are used for AV testing, with live autonomous bus services planned in three towns by 2023.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: Indeed, Mr Chairman, we have a rough timeline.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: So, today, we have about 70 km of roads in one-north being used for on-road AV testings.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: The next phase, having established the on-road safety, is then to integrate these AVs into "live" operations.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: We have committed to making that possible in three towns by 2023: Tengah, Jurong Innovation District and Punggol.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: What that would mean is that we will have autonomous buses as a sort of 'live" service, integrated with the other bus services that are available.
